item.title: fix(scripts): avoid false PR head changes during GitHub outages (#125…
item.summary: fix(scripts): avoid false PR head changes during GitHub outages (#125517) gh exit status was treated as proof that stdout held a PR object. The Octopool cache shim reports upstream 5xx responses as exit 0 with empty stdout, so reads now use a bounded-retry validation helper. Convert 9 of 28 gh pr view sites where an empty payload could produce a wrong decision.
